title: Give retirement village inquiry and disclosure documents
what: Give a prospective resident the residence contract, the disclosure statement and the other listed documents at least 10 business days before the contract.

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 2016 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The operator of a retirement village must, at least 10 business days before a person enters into a residence contract, give the person a copy of each of the following documents: (a) the residence contract; (b) the disclosure statement;

reach.condition: if it operates a retirement village
